description: This file defines a helper class ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper used for retrieving cluster status and health information within a distributed system. It interacts with Akka actor system to gather and process status data from cluster nodes, supporting functionalities like role-based status and health collection, and JSON-based representation.

classes.name: ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper
classes.description: A helper class for retrieving cluster status and health information via Akka ActorSystem, supporting role-based status and health collection as JSON objects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper with provided ActorSystem, cluster status supplier, and health check configuration.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesStatus
methods.description: Retrieves JSON status information for each role in the cluster by querying each reachable node asynchronously.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesHealth
methods.description: Retrieves health status information for each role in the cluster, including missing and extra roles, as a structured StatusInfo object.
